title: Peter - the Rock
introduction: Peter was a fisherman who became Jesus' closest disciple. Impulsive and passionate, he denied Jesus three times—but was restored and became a cornerstone of the early church. His life shows that God uses imperfect people.

sections.title: The Call by the Sea
sections.description: Jesus called Peter to become a fisher of men.

sections.title: The Confession
sections.description: Peter confessed that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of the living God.

sections.title: The Fall
sections.description: Peter denied Jesus three times, just as Jesus had predicted.

sections.title: Restoration
sections.description: The risen Jesus restored Peter by the Sea of Galilee.

sections.title: Leader in the Early Church
sections.description: Peter became a bold preacher and leader in the early church.
